source.author: stat
source.text: Fama prior mundique arcana Vetustas, cui meminisse ducum vitasque extendere curae, pande viros, tuque o nemoris regina seniori.
source.text_original: Fama prior mundique arcana Vetustas, / cui meminisse ducum vitasque extendere curae, / pande viros, tuque o nemoris regina seniori.
source.text_english: Earlier fame and ancient Time, keeper of the world’s secrets, whose care it is to remember leaders and to prolong their lives, disclose the men, and you too, O queen of the grove, lend support to an elder singer.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: versam proles tua pandet Idumen namque potest : Solymo nigrantem pulvere fratrem spargentemque faces et in omni turre furentem.
reuse.text_original: versam proles tua pandet Idumen / (namque potest ): Solymo nigrantem pulvere fratrem / spargentemque faces et in omni turre furentem.
reuse.text_english: Your offspring will reveal Idumea turned over, for it can: the brother darkened with dust of Jerusalem, scattering torches and raging in every tower.
